turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My grandson is struggling with times tables. Any tricks I can teach him?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lots. Which ones give him the most trouble?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: There's a little rhyme for eight times eight. I ate and I ate till I was sick on the floor, eight times eight is sixty four.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ha, he'll love that. What about the sevens?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For those, practise in short bursts while doing something else, like counting stairs in sevens or clapping a rhythm.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: just repeating them over and over.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That works too, but games make it stick better, and it's more fun for you both.
